paragraphs.source_en: Remember, you are also recording all the money that flows into your life; you may want to establish subcategories for income also. It is important to distinguish between wages/salaries/tips and interest/dividend income; your primary income versus your “side hustle.” Where will you record the dimes you find on the sidewalk, the quarters you retrieve from vending machines, and your gambling winnings? If you are an independent contractor, you likely have a separate line for each client on your business accounts, but when you pay yourself you might just have subcategories for each type of work: dog walking, handyman, coaching, substitute teaching, renting your guest room to travelers. As you go along in this program, you might have an income category called Selling Off My Clutter and subcategories called eBay, Yard Sales, and Antiques.
